data: Excellent game - very relaxing and gorgeous
Love it, and can't wait to see more updates
Great game, great graphics, controls are simple, game runs smoothly, extremely nice game to unwind to
A really good game, very well polished and fun to play, with great music and sfx
i highly recommend this game, it is so fun and definitely worth the price (only $15
incredibly cozy sandbox, very fun to just zone out and build whatever comes to mind

Great Castle and town building game. Not very many components but no limitations on how they are used which means that the simplicity is great to dive into and find all of the different ways you can use different components

It's not a game, it's an artistic tool. And it's a beautiful one, assuming what you want to create can be expressed in terms of ye olde buildings.

It should really be in the "software" section of Steam, though I guess that gets fewer eyeballs.

Calm and creative. If you like realistic building games that are relaxing then you'll probably like this game. there are a few restrictions but its the best building game I've found. I think it would be cool if we had the option to add people, animals, and specific plants; however the game is pretty amazing as is!

A fantastic toybox game built off a similar engine to Townscaper. Build beautiful little cottage core vistas on a gridless square. It's a lot more customizable and aesthetic than Townscaper, and a bit more expensive.

The industry could learn something from these "toy" sandbox type games. Just like art, not everything needs a goal or meaning or conflict, sometimes meditating on a cute little thing you built is all you need to be entertained. I think stuff like this would be fantastic for art therapy, drawing references, and so on.

Only having played 2 hours i can say that this is the most therapeutic and soothing game. The way walls adapt to changes is satisfying to see. I can easily see myself getting a couple hundred hours from it easily. At it's price, it is very well worth it.
Really relaxing and cozy game. Limited tools already allow for tons of creativity but still hoping for future additions!

This game is relaxing and adorable. no story or quests. just simple town building. The sound design is gorgeous. and the soundtrack is serene and lovely. personally i love just playing this after a stressful game, or just when mindlessly chatting with friends.

Very relaxing. A lot more fun than I was expecting with the simplicity of the game. I find myself thinking about what I would like to build randomly throughout the day when I'm not playing. It's been a great game to play with my daughter, who also really likes it.

played for 21 minutes, realized how little there actually is to build unless your crazy creative, and even then your structures are super limited. this game is not worth 15 dollars, not even close to it. the music is cool, its chill but i wouldn't even pay 5 dollars.

Simple and fun, affordable price

Could benefit from some UI tooltips (everything is icons, meaning not always obvious) and use of the delete key instead of having to switch to a delete tool, but those are minor complaints
It's a lovely game with good mechanics and is a lovely game to relax to.

In one week I put in 33.6 hours. This has been the most fun I've had playing a single player game in years. I will get lost in a build for hours and have a great time doing it. This game has scratched an itch in my brain that I haven't experienced since the early days of roller coaster tycoon (arid heights map) and building houses in Sims. The sheer creativity this game holds is staggering for how simple the game is. Highly recommend for fans of the genre and I hope the devs continue to improve and add to it.
I really like this game, however, the maps are a little small, it would be nice to be able to build a big village or something, and be great to have little villagers etc.

It's honestly very cozy and tickles my brain in all the right places.

Waiting for more build area, more cute animals, more themes, more spawn decorations
...and possibly a co-op mod? Building with friends would make it a lot more fun imo.

Perfect little cozy game that allows you to build small houses, lush castles and more in a gorgeous sandbox. UI is deceptively simple, with minimalist but very effective tools/controls; you can actually do a lot with each individual building element to get it into the shape that you want. Devs keep adding small new features to enhance the game without it being overwhelming or confusing.

You can put as much or little time into this as you want, and you'll still get something done. Give it a quick whirl just to relax and pass the time, get creative manipulating the building elements into new shapes and features, or go down the rabbit hole of layering to achieve complex architectures, and even build your own city.

Oh, and don't forget to pet your sheep. <3

I really like this game, I hope the devs keep adding features! its relaxing. You have to get creative with the limited tools there are to make cool things like market places ect. so maybe a few more tool options would be nice, and a few more animals than just sheep and ducks. The ability to colour change flowers. and adding fence gates. I hope this game exspands, it has alot of potential. worth buying for what it is still though.
This game is a treat. Whoever designed the UI/UX, I love how your brain works. You have a sexy brain, a beautiful brain. The dev or devs are all sexy beautiful people.
I love coming back to this game after a long day at school! The updates always provide amazing surprises when I try something new! <3

This game is ideal for others like me who enjoy using their own creativity to create virtually whatever. Super zen and calm, very cute aesthetic to it as well. The only thing is I wish that you could decorate the inside of the buildings. For example, like couches and paintings and whatnot. (Devs, how bout it?)

I have followed the developement of this since I stumbled upon the devs in 2020 and have been hyped up to play this.
Since my tower died (RIP) I had to wait for it to come out for Mac BUT OH MY GOD! this game is super statisfying and just pretty and cute. AND I cannot get over the Mechanics of scaling and pulling building into existence. Also you can PET THE SHEEP AND DUCKS! 
Immaculate Sound design as well I am surprised again and again how much detail is in this game. 
Not going to lie, it takes a bit to get used to but when you´ve got it its incredibly intuitive.

There are no goals or objectives, I have the feeling that development is still continuing and maybe more features will be added (I´d love more Clutter and color choices for vegetation- also waterfalls please) but it´s very solid and an incredible sandbox for quiet unwinding (also the building community is extremely impressive and innovative so check it out).
All in all I can only recomennd it especially if you love stimmy building games with statisfying sound design (The Brick noise is faboulous).
lovely game for removing stress, scratching the creative itch and giving you a little fuzzy feeling for a while.

I've been wanting a castle sandbox game like this forever. I just bought it last night and I can tell I will play this into the ground. It's great as is but I would love if they expanded the detail opportunities! For sure would recommend.

This game is delightful and can be as simple or complex as you want it to be. Also it's gorgeous and the music is very calming. This is my go-to game for when I'm tired and just want to relax and be happy about something.
Very relaxing chill game, price is awesome as well. Would recommend to anyone to have fun and lower stress! I hope the best for Pounce Light.

Tiny Glade is one of the best cosy games ive ever played. your possibilities are litterally endless, aesthetic builds, great lighting and wonderful music with the ability to pet the animals!!! Id like to make some dnd villages and scenery with this in the future, theres also a first person walk around camera view that just really sucks you into the game. I love this so much and i reccomend it to anyone.
this game is the best game ever its so pretty i love it so much you should 100% get it, its so epic

I absolutely love Tiny Glade! It's the game I go to for comfort, it feels very meditative and always gets me in a good mood. The gameplay is fun and calming - I love creating my own little villages, cities and houses. Also the little animals are an absolute joy to see. Overall this game is so pretty and very relaxing to play!
Love the ease of getting into this game, just building some cool castles and villages, and appreciating the sometimes surprising combinations that tools create.

its very fun and gets updates regularly. i think they ned too add the ability to make waterfalls by adding water on raised terrain and add water flowing down raised terrain depending on the steepnes of the terrain it becomes a waterfall and they need to add the ability to turn trees into tree stumps or have a clutter of a stump with an axe in it so i can add a lumberjack house to the village
it's a very cozy and relaxeing game to play and helped calm me down and was a great way to exspress myself I love this game and I think others will too.

The game is aesthetically beautiful but I am disappointed by how functionally limited it is. You can only work within a cramped square of space and there are only a few options for buildings. As it stands this is not worth the $15 price tag.
perfect game to play when you're feeling under the weather. or when you wanna relax and be creative. recommended best played with a bowl of ramen, warm snuddie and music. 10/10
Take this same model and develop a game to make super cozy tiny houses interior and exteriors.
A really cozy and fun game. The visuals are magical and really enjoyable to watch come to life! Controller support could definitely be better, but that's my only issue so far.

This is such an amazingly fun and interesting game. The customisation is amazing and the graphics are staggeringly good. There a lot of things that should be added but this game is new so it is understandable that they are missing and it really doesn't make it less fun! Would definitely recommend, such a calming game.

This game is adorable in every way! The graphics are gorgeous and the music is absolutely perfect. I love building little towns and houses and petting the sheep and ducks- it's all very calming. Definitely get this game if you're considering it!

The game is really nice, really relaxing. I love the sound design particularly, and the artsyle is cute and colorfull. 
Also there's a lot of possibilities for building,different biomes etc... 

10/10 would recommend.
Just the most cozy, fun, creative, and cozy again game. The devs did an awesome job, and they continue to do amazing work with all the updates!
Stimming in videogame form. Many features are not explained up front but instead exist for you to discover. Go into it with an explorative mind.
Its a cozy building game with relaxing music. Good for some rest after an exhausting day
Beautiful design and very relaxing. Like me if you want to come home after a long day and reward yourself with peace you should definitely try this game.

Very cozy and relaxing and I love the care that went into fleshing out details for you.

I felt like some bigger decorations were missing. It's nice that you can add lamp posts but I wanted to add a well among many of the buildings to explain the layout of buildings.

I don't know how I feel about building styles being locked behind seasons/settings.

I feel like this game could use workshop integration. I have no idea how complex modding would be for this game. But it would be interesting to see maybe baroque style buildings, or wooden buildings like in a small village, or maybe even something like high fantasy

It's not really a game, but more of a diorama builder. It's a very chill experience with no time constraints, levels, points, or other things. It's just about being creative and making some cool stuff.

Lowkey one of the best games I've played
No objectives, just calming building and I really like that :)
Graphics are beautiful too

An excellent game—you can play for hours without getting bored, especially with the new update; now you can control those fine details without scrolling forever. The game's visuals and art style are really good, and there are no rendering issues.

this is the coziest game in this platform i just love building little towns and villages its so relaxing, i just wish there was more decorative items (like statues, wells, shops, stalls) and maybe some more architecture elements (pillars, buttress, bigger gothic windows for making churches etc)
Tiny Glade is SUCH beautiful, cozy, stress free building game. Not only is it a creative outlet, but I also find it to be a valuable resource when creating maps and scenery for online dnd campaigns.

Nice and relaxing, Respectfully, I wouldn't call it a game. It seems more like a 3D landscaping program, primarily because it lacks all the standard gaming requirements. But, regardless of that point. Very intuitive, calming and could be fun however. i know it is fairly new and always being worked on and upgraded, i wanted to suggest a few ideas that i know have been brought up in other comments.

-The building process is nice but too randomized when it comes to detail artifacts (ie. clutter, doors and windows).
-More road and path styles.
-Map size and environment types. (deserts, tundras, coastlines.) main menu options perhaps
-More intuitive terrain tools. (More defined boulders and rocks, hills, cliffs, ravines, mountains, canyons
caves and tunnels, grass and cliff-vines.)
-More intuitive water tools. (Waterfalls and other water features; brooks, streams, irrigation ditches, fountains, and aqueducts
-Architecture styles, flora and fauna. (Fairy-tale creatures or different farm animals and wildlife. plants like mangroves. tropical jungle and alpine plants).
-Market stalls and shops. banners and signs and more fence types.
-Random villagers wandering about going about their business in town.

Knowing that making this game and continuous improvements is demanding, these are only suggestions and not expected. Perhaps, in future updates or later DLC's; like a Victorian style DLC, Elven Forest DLC. Japanese architecture etc. id definitely pay for them.
Must buy. After a depressing day at work, this will put a smile back on your face! Gorgeous and so relaxing <3

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (97%) on Steam, with 21% of reviews praising the graphics and art.
Complaints are few and spread across different topics, so no single problem stands out.

details.text: Reviews from the last 30 days are about as positive as the all-time score, so the rating has held steady.
Players with under 2 hours give it 93% positive, while players with over 50 hours give it 99%, so newer players are a little less enthusiastic.
